description: Answer one specific question, such as a number, a status or a decision, from the most relevant excerpts of an ingested board, with validated source citations or an insufficient-evidence result. It finds excerpts by the question's words (whole words, ignoring case and accents (words of five or more letters also match compounds that begin with them); no other word forms, synonyms or translations), so ask with the board's words and language. Keep its citations (node ID and Figma link) with the statements they support. It reads only a handful of excerpts: not for summaries, lists, risks or next steps across several sections; read those with get_board_context. Sends the question and the selected excerpts to the configured LLM provider; calls may incur charges.

boardId.description: The Figma file key returned by ingest_board, or the board URL

name: answer_from_board

frameNames.description: Names of enclosing frames and groups, outermost first

ignoredArguments.description: Unknown input keys that were ignored; their values are not echoed. Absent when none
